answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring capital commitment to validate transactions. An attacker must scale a massive quill of signatures across a high ridge of staked collateral to influence consensus, which becomes economically infeasible. Like a rare pearl buried in decentralized data, the integrity of the network relies on this financial threshold, ensuring that the cost of generating fake identities exceeds the potential gain from protocol subversion.
